HORIZONS bundled Arabic fonts
==============================

These unmodified TrueType fonts are bundled so the workbook keeps the same
Arabic letterforms and diacritic placement while fully offline. No font is
downloaded from a CDN or another network service.

Noto Naskh Arabic (Regular, Bold)
Noto Sans Arabic (Regular, Bold)
Noto Kufi Arabic (Regular, Bold)
  Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors.
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL-NotoArabic.txt.

Amiri (Regular, Bold)
  Copyright 2010-2022 The Amiri Project Authors.
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL-Amiri.txt.

Scheherazade (Regular, Bold)
  Copyright 1994-2015 SIL International.
  Reserved Font Names: "Scheherazade" and "SIL".
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL-Scheherazade.txt.

Default screen face: Noto Naskh Arabic. It is used as the default because its
Naskh proportions remain familiar while its vowel marks and dots stay clear at
phone and tablet sizes. Learners can switch among all five families locally.

Source of the exact bundled binaries: the LibreOffice font distribution in the
Codex primary runtime. The font files have not been modified.
